name: How to Build a Daily Reading Habit
equipment: A book you are currently reading
instructions: Remove friction between you and reading -- a bookmark always in place, the book on your pillow, not buried in a bag.
Track your streak somewhere visible; watching consecutive days build is its own motivation.
Give yourself permission to read "badly" some days -- a single page still counts and keeps the streak alive.
Watch today's video for more habit-building strategies.
